name: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) Approximation
definition: A splatting method using unnormalized Gaussians that preserves 2D amplitude $a'$ (called 'opacity') across projections, unlike EWA which preserves weight $w$.
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a real-time rendering method using unnormalized 2D Gaussians that simplifies volumetric integration by assuming uniform color and ignoring perspective distortion.
